query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `content` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `topic` text NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `imageUrl` text,
  `imagePrompt` text,
  `status` enum('draft','in_progress','approved') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `progress` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `contentType` enum('blog-post','how-to','listicle','case-study','guide','news','newsletter','email-sequence','social-post','press-release','landing-page','video-script','whitepaper','product-description') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'blog-post',
  `contentSubtype` varchar(64),
  `aiModel` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gpt-4o',
  `customPrompt` text,
  `inputTokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `outputTokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `totalTokens` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `urlsFetched` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `urlsFailed` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `webSearches` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `scheduledPublishDate` timestamp NULL,
  `isScheduled` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `wordCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `wasApproved` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `approvedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `generationTimeMs` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
